title: Themes
description: Theme grid with activate / preview / details. Reads via `core-data` `'root','theme'` entity.

documentation.purpose: Grid view of installed themes with screenshot + activate / details actions. The active theme floats to the front; the remainder sorts alphabetically. Activation uses a custom `/wp-admin-shell/v1/activate-theme` endpoint with a graceful fall-back to wp-admin's `themes.php?action=activate` link if the endpoint is missing. Details modal surfaces description + version + author + theme-site link.

reads.purpose: Fallback for active stylesheet lookup before core-data hydrates.

writes.purpose: Switch the active theme via the shell's custom endpoint.

states.renders: Header (count) + 3-column grid of theme cards. Active card has an Active badge; non-active cards show Activate button.
Modal with large screenshot + description + version / author + Theme site / Activate buttons.

interactions.trigger: Click Details on a theme card
interactions.effect: Open the details modal with that theme.

interactions.trigger: Click Activate on a theme card
interactions.effect: POST `/wp-admin-shell/v1/activate-theme` with `{ stylesheet }`; on success invalidate `root/theme` + close any open modal. On failure: `window.location.href` to `themes.php?action=activate&stylesheet=...` so the user falls back to wp-admin.

a11y.focus-management: Legacy `Modal` traps focus while open. After close (via Esc or backdrop click) focus returns to the trigger button.

constraints.note: WordPress core REST does not expose a theme-switch operation. The shell ships a custom `/wp-admin-shell/v1/activate-theme` endpoint; rebuilds must provide the equivalent or implement the wp-admin link fall-back.

If the custom endpoint 404s (older shell version or stripped feature), the app navigates to wp-admin's `themes.php` flow so the user can complete the action — preserves the right outcome even without the optimized path.
Uses legacy `Modal` from `@wordpress/components`; WPDS Dialog 0.12 lacks size variants.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Theme card layout, header, action buttons.
Grid layout, screenshot media slot, loading spinner, details modal — all WPDS 0.12 gaps.
